EMPTY_WARNING.TITLE: Any website can embed this widget
EMPTY_WARNING.BODY: While this field is blank, the server sends no frame-protection header, and any page on the internet can load this widget inside an iframe — including a site impersonating yours to collect data from people who believe they are talking to you.
EMPTY_WARNING.ACTION_HINT: To close this, list the domains where the widget should work — one per line. Include all of them: main domain, subdomains, staging, and any other site of the same company. A missing domain stops showing the widget.

SAVE_BAR.PENDING: No pending changes | 1 unsaved change | {count} unsaved changes

UNSAVED_DIALOG.TITLE: Leave without saving?
UNSAVED_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: These changes were not written yet. If you leave now, they are lost.

CONTRAST.INVALID: Enter a hex color (for example #2DC46F) to see the contrast readout.

EXPLANATION.TEXT: On a light background, {brand} as text gives {ratio}:1 — below the legible minimum. Links and labels will use {adjusted} ({adjustedRatio}:1). The fill stays {brand}.
EXPLANATION.BORDER: As a border and focus ring, {brand} gives {ratio}:1 — below the 3:1 an interface element needs. Borders and focus will use {adjusted} ({adjustedRatio}:1).

OVERRIDE.TITLE: The website overrides this setting
OVERRIDE.BODY: The code installed on the website sets {fields} on its own. What is saved here is the default and the website wins — to make this screen's value count, remove the field from the chatwootSettings object on the site.

THEME.LABEL: Theme mode
THEME.HELP: Automatic follows the visitor's system theme.

AUTO.LABEL: Automatic
AUTO.DESCRIPTION: Follows the system theme of whoever visits the site.

POSITIONS.LEFT_HINT: The bubble sits in the bottom-left corner.
POSITIONS.RIGHT_HINT: The bubble sits in the bottom-right corner.

LAUNCHER.OFFSETS_HINT: In pixels, from 0 to 120. Useful when another element of the site takes the corner.

TYPES.STANDARD_HINT: Just the icon, in a circle.
TYPES.EXPANDED_BUBBLE_HINT: The icon with a call next to it.

LAUNCHER.HIDE_BUBBLE_HINT: Removes the launcher. Only do this if the site opens the chat from its own button — with no launcher and no button, the visitor is left with no way to reach you.

FEATURES.END_CONVERSATION: Let the visitor end the conversation
FEATURES.USE_INBOX_AVATAR_FOR_BOT: Use the inbox name and avatar for the bot

ADVANCED.PANEL_STYLE_HINT: Standard has the header in the brand color; flat uses a neutral background.

SUPPORT.LABEL: Support
SUPPORT.DESCRIPTION: For people who already are customers and need help. The widget waits for the click: no invitation, no teaser, CSAT at the end and history over email.

MARKETING.LABEL: Marketing
MARKETING.DESCRIPTION: To turn a visitor into a customer. The widget invites — teaser on a trigger, qualification in the pre-chat and a conversion event at the end.

PROFILE.QUESTION: What is this inbox for?
PROFILE.QUESTION_HELP: Pick now so the inbox is born right. You can change it later, and changing never erases what you configured.
PROFILE.HIDDEN_HINT: The {profile} profile hides these sections — it does not remove them. They stay saved and come back if you switch the profile.

SWITCH_DIALOG.TITLE: Switch this inbox profile
SWITCH_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: The {profile} profile proposes the changes below. Check what you want applied — anything left unchecked is not touched.
SWITCH_DIALOG.WILL_CHANGE: What changes, if you check it
SWITCH_DIALOG.KEEP_EXPLANATION: Nothing is erased. Every setting of the previous profile stays in the database, inert, and comes back if you switch the profile back.
SWITCH_DIALOG.NOTHING_CHANGES: Nothing changes: this inbox is already set the way the new profile proposes.

PRECHATFORMENABLED.SUPPORT: Turn the pre-chat form off (the customer talks first, no form)
PRECHATFORMENABLED.MARKETING: Turn the pre-chat form on (to qualify the visitor before the conversation)

TRIGGERSPRESET.SUPPORT: Turn triggers off: the widget goes back to waiting for the click
TRIGGERSPRESET.MARKETING: Turn the teaser on with the composite trigger (8 seconds on page AND 30% scroll)

CONTINUITYVIAEMAIL.SUPPORT: Turn email continuity on (history follows into the customer's inbox)

CSATSURVEYENABLED.SUPPORT: Turn the satisfaction survey (CSAT) on when a conversation is resolved

KNOWLEDGEBASE.SUPPORT: Show the Help Center on the widget home screen
KNOWLEDGEBASE.MARKETING: Hide the Help Center on the widget home screen
